The '''Morytania Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas within and around [[Morytania]], such as [[Paterdomus]], [[Harmony Island]], and [[Mos Le'Harmless]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Completion of [[Priest in Peril]] is required for all tasks, as it is needed to enter Morytania. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Le-sabrè]] just west of [[Canifis]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Morytania" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Craft any [[Snelm]] from scratch in [[Morytania]].
''Note: Must be done outside of [[Mort Myre Swamp]].
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|15|link=y}}
*[[Chisel]] 
*Any [[blamish shell]]
|-
|2. Cook a [[thin Snail]] on the [[Port Phasmatys]] [[range]].
|
*{{SCP|Cooking|12|link=y}}
*[[Thin snail]]
*2 [[Ecto-tokens]] or quest completion of [[Ghosts Ahoy]] to walk into [[Port Phasmatys]], or enough [[coins]] for a [[charter ship]].
|-
|3. Get a [[slayer task]] from the [[Mazchna|Slayer Master]] in [[Canifis]].
|
*{{SCP|Combat|20|link=y}}
|-
|4. Kill a [[Banshee]] in the [[Slayer Tower]].
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|15|link=y}}
*[[Earmuffs]] or [[Slayer helmet]] recommended
|-
|5. Have [[Sbott]] in [[Canifis]] tan something for you.
|
*Any tannable [[hide]] and 2-45 [[coins]] depending on the type of hide
|-
|6. Enter [[Mort Myre Swamp]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|7. Kill a [[Ghoul]].
|
*[[Weaponry]]
|-
|8. Place a [[Scarecrow]] in the Morytania [[Flower patch#Flower patches|flower patch]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|23|link=yes}} ([[Ironman mode|Ironman accounts]] require {{SCP|Farming|47|link=yes}} or the ability to kill [[gryphon]]s)
*[[Bronze spear]], [[watermelon]], and a [[hay sack]]
|-
|9. Offer some [[bonemeal]] at the [[Ectofuntus]].
|
*[[Pot]], [[bucket]], and any [[bones]]
|-
|10. Kill a [[werewolf]] in its human form using the [[Wolfbane|Wolfbane Dagger]]{{sic}}.
|
*[[Wolfbane]]
|-
|11. Restore your [[prayer points]] at the [[Nature Grotto|nature altar]].
''Note: Requires you to have less than full [[Prayer points]]. If able, activate [[Piety]] while praying here to complete a [[#Hard|hard task]].''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Nature Spirit]]
*[[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]] recommended to travel to [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|bip}}
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Morytania legs 1]]:
**Two daily teleports to the [[Pool of Slime]] beneath the [[Ectofuntus]]
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*[[Ghast]]s in the [[Mort Myre Swamp]] will ignore you half of the time
*2.5% more [[Slayer]] experience in the [[Slayer Tower]] while on a [[Slayer task]]

==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Morytania" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Catch a [[Swamp lizard (Hunter)|swamp lizard]].
|
*{{SCP|Hunter|29|link=y}}
*[[Rope]] and [[small fishing net]]
|-
|2. Complete a lap of the [[Canifis Rooftop Course|Canifis agility course]]. 
|
*{{SCP|Agility|40|link=y}}
|-
|3. Obtain some [[bark|Bark]] from a [[Hollow tree]].
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|45|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]]
|-
|4. Travel to [[Dragontooth Island|Dragontooth Isle]].
''Note: This task is automatically completed during [[Ghosts Ahoy]].''
|
*[[Ghostspeak amulet]] and 25 [[ecto-token]]s (or 10 with the [[Ring of Charos(a)]])
|-
|5. Kill a [[terror dog|Terror Dog]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lair of Tarn Razorlor]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|40|link=y}}
*[[Weaponry]]
*[[Slayer ring]] recommended for quick access to [[Tarn's Lair]]
|-
|6. Complete a game of [[trouble brewing]].
''Note: You only have to complete the minigame once, winning it is optional. In Deadman Mode, the task is instead "Speak to Honest Jimmy about Trouble Brewing."''
|
*Completion of [[Cabin Fever]]
*{{SCP|Cooking|40|link=y}}
*Empty [[inventory]] and [[Worn_Equipment#Head_slot|head slot]]
*At least one opposing player to start the game
|-
|7. Board the [[Swamp Boaty|Swampy boat]]{{Sic}} at the [[Hollows]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Quest start of [[Nature Spirit]]
*[[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]] recommended to travel to [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|bkr}}
|-
|8. Make a batch of [[cannonball]]s at the [[Port Phasmatys]] furnace.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Dwarf Cannon]]
*{{SCP|Smithing|35|link=y}}
*[[Steel bar]] and [[ammo mould]] (or 2 [[steel bar]]s and [[double ammo mould]])
|-
|9. Kill a [[Fever Spider]] on [[Braindeath Island]].
''Note: This task is automatically completed during [[Rum Deal]].''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Rum Deal]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|42|link=y}}
*[[Weaponry]] to fight at range, or means to negate [[disease]] (such as [[Slayer gloves]]), recommended
|-
|10. Use an [[ectophial]] to return to [[Port Phasmatys]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Ghosts Ahoy]]
*[[Ectophial]]
|-
|11. Mix a [[Guthix Balance]] potion while in [[Morytania]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[In Aid of the Myreque]]
*{{SCP|Herblore|22|link=y}}
*[[Restore potion]], [[garlic]], and [[silver dust]] (made by using a [[silver bar]] on the [[Bone grinder|Ectofuntus bone grinder]])
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Morytania legs 2]]:
**Five daily teleports to the [[Pool of Slime]] beneath the [[Ectofuntus]]
**Acts as a [[ghostspeak amulet]] when worn
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*[[Robin]] exchanges 13 [[Remains#Bones|bones]] of any kind daily for a [[bucket of slime]] and a pot of [[bonemeal]] each
*5% more [[Slayer]] experience in the [[Slayer Tower]] while on a [[Slayer task]], up from 2.5%
*The amount of [[blood runes]] obtained for trading in a fully-grown [[dog]] with a [[Mysterious Stranger (dog)|Mysterious Stranger]] in [[Ver Sinhaza]] is increased to 200, up from 100.

==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Morytania" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Enter the [[Kharyrll Portal]] in your [[POH]].
''Note: Teleporting to [[Kharyrll]] from a more expensive [[portal nexus]] also counts for this task. Higher-tier materials can optionally be used for the [[Portal space|portal]] and [[Portal_chamber#Centrepiece|centrepiece]].''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Desert Treasure I]]
*{{SCP|Magic|66|link=y}} and {{SCP|Construction|50|link=y}}
*100,000 [[coins]], 2 [[limestone brick]]s, 3 [[teak plank]]s, [[hammer]], and [[saw]] to construct a [[portal chamber]] with an activatable [[teak portal]] and [[teleport focus]], if you haven't already
*200 [[law rune]]s and 100 [[blood rune]]s to direct a portal to [[Kharyrll]], or 2000 law runes and 1000 blood runes if adding the portal to a [[portal nexus]] instead
|-
|2. Climb up the [[Spikey_chain_(Slayer_Tower)#Advanced|advanced spike chain]] within [[Slayer Tower]].
''Note: This chain is located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} near the [[Infernal Mage]]s, leading to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} to near the [[Nechryael]].''
|
*{{SCP|Agility|71|link=y}} {{Boostable|yes}}
*[[Slayer helmet]] or [[nose peg]] recommended against the [[aberrant spectre]]s, when climbing the [[Spikey_chain_(Slayer_Tower)|spikey chain]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} as a shortcut to the [[Spikey_chain_(Slayer_Tower)#Advanced|advanced spikey chain]]
*Only a successful climb (not taking damage) will count as task completed.
|-
|3. Harvest some [[Watermelon]] from the [[Allotment patch]] on [[Harmony Island]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[The Great Brain Robbery]]
*{{SCP|Farming|47|link=y}}
*3 [[watermelon seed]]s, [[spade]], [[seed dibber]] (or [[Barbarian Farming]]), and a [[rake]]
*[[Ultracompost]] recommended
|-
|4. Chop and burn some [[mahogany logs]] on [[Mos Le'Harmless]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Cabin Fever]]
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|50|link=y}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|50|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]] and a [[tinderbox]]
*[[Witchwood icon]] and a [[light source]] (if [[Fire of Eternal Light]] has not been built) recommended
|-
|5. Complete a [[Temple Trekking|temple trek]] with a hard companion.
''Note: Completion of [[Darkness of Hallowvale]] unlocks the reverse route. It's not necessary to complete any events for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[In Aid of the Myreque]]
*See the [[Temple_Trekking#Recommendations|recommendations]]
|-
|6. Kill a [[cave horror|Cave Horror]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Cabin Fever]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|58|link=y}}
*[[Witchwood icon]] and a [[light source]] 
|-
|7. Harvest some [[Mushroom|Bittercap Mushrooms]] from the patch in [[Canifis]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|53|link=y}}
*[[Mushroom spore]], [[seed dibber]] (or [[Barbarian Farming]]), and a [[rake]]
*[[Ultracompost]] recommended
|-
|8. Pray at the [[Nature Grotto|Altar of Nature]] with [[Piety]] activated.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Nature Spirit]] and the [[Knight Waves Training Grounds]] (which requires completion of [[King's Ransom]])
*{{SCP|Prayer|70|link=y}} and {{SCP|Defence|70|link=y}} (neither [[Temporary skill boost|boostable]])
*[[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]] recommended to travel to [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|bip}}
|-
|9. Use the shortcut to get to the bridge over [[River Salve|the Salve]].
''Note: You have to use the shortcut to go downwards for this task, not upwards.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|65|link=y}}
|-
|10. Mine some [[Mithril ore]] in the [[Abandoned Mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Haunted Mine]]
*{{SCP|Mining|55|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
*[[Crystal-mine key]] recommended (allows use of veins on Level 2, right next to the secret entrance)
|}
===Rewards===
*[[Morytania legs 3]]:
**Unlimited teleports to [[Burgh de Rott]]
**Plus the same benefits as Morytania legs 2:
***Five daily teleports to the Pool of Slime beneath the Ectofuntus
***Acts as a ghostspeak amulet when worn
*[[Bonecrusher]], claimable from a [[ghost disciple]] while wearing a [[ghostspeak amulet]] or [[Morytania legs 3]]+
**An additional item that, when carried, causes [[Remains#Bones|bones]] dropped from killed monsters to be automatically buried, granting half the usual [[Prayer]] experience that would have been granted for burying them normally
**This item is [[Bonecrusher#Charging|charged]] with a small amount of [[ecto-token]]s
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*[[Robin]] exchanges 26 [[Remains#Bones|bones]] of any kind daily for a [[bucket of slime]] and a pot of [[bonemeal]] each, up from 13
*Double [[Mort myre fungus|Mort myre fungi]] when casting [[Bloom]]
*50% more [[Prayer]] experience from burning shade remains
*50% more [[runes]] from the [[Barrows chest]]
*7.5% more [[Slayer]] experience in the [[Slayer Tower]] while on a [[Slayer task]], up from 5%

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Morytania" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Catch a [[shark]] in [[Burgh de Rott]] with your bare hands.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[In Aid of the Myreque]]
*Access to [[Barbarian Fishing]]
*{{SCP|Fishing|96|link=y}} and {{SCP|Strength|76|link=y}} (both are [[Temporary skill boost|boostable]])
*[[Shark lure]] recommended
*If you are boosting with the [[Dragon harpoon]] special attack, you need to bank or drop the harpoon before catching the shark, or store it in a [[tackle box]]. Having it in the inventory will use it by default and it will not count as barehanded.
|-
|2. Cremate any [[Shade remains]] on a [[Magic pyre logs|Magic]] or [[Redwood pyre logs|Redwood pyre]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Shades of Mort'ton]]
*{{SCP|Firemaking|80|link=y}} {{Boostable|yes}}
*[[Magic pyre logs|Magic]] or [[Redwood pyre logs]], any [[shade remains]], and a [[tinderbox]]
|-
|3. Fertilize the [[Morytania]] [[herb patch]] using [[Lunar spells|Lunar Magic]].
''Note: This herb patch is located west of [[Port Phasmatys]].''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]]
*{{SCP|Magic|83|link=y}}
*[[Lunar spellbook]] selected
*Means to cast [[Fertile Soil]] ({{RuneReq|Nature=2|Astral=3|Earth=15}})
|-
|4. Craft a [[Black d'hide body|Black dragonhide body]] in [[Canifis bank]].
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|84|link=y}}
*3 [[black dragon leather]], and a [[needle]] and [[thread]] or the [[costume needle]]
|-
|5. Kill an [[Abyssal demon]] in the [[Slayer Tower]].
''Note: [[Abyssal demon]]s on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} do not require a [[Slayer task]] to kill like those in the basement.''
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|85|link=y}}
*[[Weaponry]]
|-
|6. Loot the [[Barrows chest]] while wearing any complete [[Barrows equipment|barrows set]].
''Note: This includes the weapon that is part of the equipped set.
|
*{{SCP|Defence|70|link=y}}{{boostable|no}} 
*Various other skill requirements depending on the set used, none of which can be [[Temporary skill boost|boosted]]:
**{{SCP|Attack|70|link=y}} and {{SCP|Magic|70|link=y}} for [[Ahrim the Blighted's equipment|Ahrim's]]
**{{SCP|Attack|70|link=y}} and {{SCP|Strength|70|link=y}} for [[Dharok the Wretched's equipment|Dharok's]] or [[Torag the Corrupted's equipment|Torag's]]
**{{SCP|Attack|70|link=y}} for [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's]] or [[Verac the Defiled's equipment|Verac's]]
**{{SCP|Ranged|70|link=y}} for [[Karil the Tainted's equipment|Karil's]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Morytania legs 4]]:
**Prevents [[ghast]]s from turning your [[food]] into [[rotten food]] when worn
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Pool of Slime]] beneath the [[Ectofuntus]]
**Plus the same benefits as Morytania legs 3:
***Unlimited teleports to [[Burgh de Rott]]
***Acts as a ghostspeak amulet when worn
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*[[Robin]] exchanges 39 [[Remains#Bones|bones]] of any kind daily for a [[bucket of slime]] and a pot of [[bonemeal]] each, up from 26
*50% more [[Firemaking]] experience when burning [[shade remains]]
*Bones buried via the [[Bonecrusher]] now grant full [[Prayer]] experience
*Access to the disease-free [[herb patch]] on [[Harmony Island]]
*10% more [[Slayer]] experience in the [[Slayer Tower]] while on a [[Slayer task]], up from 7.5%
